name: Edit Task
description: The user selects an existing task to update its title, due date, or status by opening the Task Form pre-filled with the task's current values. Once saved, the changes are reflected in the list.
preconditions: The Task List screen is visible
At least one task exists in the list

main_flow.description: Clicks the edit button on a task in the list
Opens the Task Form modal pre-filled with the task's current title, due date, and status
Saves the changes and updates the task in the list
Closes the modal and shows a success notification

alternative_flows.name: Title cleared
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 4, the user has removed the title, or left only whitespace, and submits
steps: System displays a validation error under the Title field

alternative_flows.name: User cancels
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 3, the user clicks Cancel or closes the modal

postconditions: The task's updated values are saved and visible in the task list
business_rules: Task title is required and cannot be cleared on edit
A title consisting only of whitespace is treated as missing
Due date and status can be changed freely

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen and at least one task exists
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks the edit button on a task, updates a field, and saves
bdd_scenarios.then: The task's updated values are shown in the list and a success notification is displayed

bdd_scenarios.given: The user has opened the Task Form in edit mode
bdd_scenarios.when: The user removes the title and tries to save
bdd_scenarios.then: A validation error is shown under the Title field and the changes are not saved

bdd_scenarios.given: The user has opened the Task Form in edit mode
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks Cancel or closes the modal
bdd_scenarios.then: The modal closes and the task remains unchanged
